search_tips.intro:
Your success in finding your Match through KOBOOL service depends greatly on your success in adding the right persons to your Acceptance List.

Simply because when you accept someone who did not accept you, your acceptance to that person will have no value. Because he/she will not know that you Accepted him/her, neither will you.
Also, adding a person to your Acceptance List reduces your chance to Match with other members in your Acceptance List who are lower in Rank.
search_tips.main_question: So, the question is.. Is there a way to know all who added me to his/her Acceptance List?
search_tips.answer:
The answer is, not all of them.

The reason for that is to let everyone selects his/her wished spouse without worrying about being rejected by that person.

clues.title:
However, Kobool gives "clues" or "hints" to guess who are interested in you.

These clues are:

clue_1.title: 1- The Photos Visibility:
clue_1.text:
There is a feature in the Photo Album management page to set the visibility of the photos to "Only people in the Acceptance List".
Since many members (specially female members) would rather not displaying their photos to the public, they have the option to show their photos only to the persons whom they have added to their Acceptance List.
So, If you could see the picture of a person (only when you are logged on) this means that he/she might has added you to his/her Acceptance List.

clue_2.title: 2- The number of visits to your personal information page:
clue_2.text:
KOBOOL counts the number of times your Profile has been visited by every member (of the opposite gender only).
When you open the Profile page of that person, you can read the number of times that person has visited your Profile page and when was the last visit (you can find it right below the Profile Title line).
You can also set the Search options to sort the search results by number of visits to your Profile page.
We believe that the more the visits you have by someone the more likely that he/she has Accepted you.

Important Note: KOBOOL does not record your visit to a member unless at least one hour has been passed since your last visit to that member.

clue_3.title: 3- The Mate description:
clue_3.text: You can know from the person's description of his wished mate whether you are the one he/she is looking for.

clue_4.title: 4- Similarities:
clue_4.text:
Always consider closer location, same religion, closer age, closer physical appearance, etc as important factors to mutual acceptances.
You can use the filters and sorting options in the Search tools to quickly find whom have similarity with you.

search_tips.final_advice: Our final advice to you is to always try to search for whom are seeking you.
